title: Yantai VTS, Longkou sector (Longkou port)
authority: Yantai MSA (中华人民共和国烟台海事局), Yantai VTS Centre (烟台船舶交通管理中心)
applies_to: Foreign ships; passenger ships; ships carrying dangerous goods; ships restricted in their ability to manoeuvre; Chinese ships of 300 GT and over; ships receiving oily water or other waste; others who join by choice. Not military, government, fishing or sports craft. A foreign crude oil tanker is always included.
applies_quote: 第四条 除军用船、公务船、渔船和体育运动船外，下列船舶在VTS区域内航行、停泊和作业时，应按规定向VTS中心进行船舶动态报告：（一）外国籍船舶；（二）客船；（三）载运危险货物的船舶；（四）操纵能力受到限制的船舶；（五）300总吨及以上中国籍船舶；（六）从事油污水等污染物接收的船舶；（七）其他自愿参加VTS动态报告的船舶。

when.text: Entry report on reaching the reporting line: ship's name, position, movement and other items the VTS asks; ships with dangerous goods also give the kind and quantity; towing ships give the tow's name and length. (驶入报告：驶抵报告线时报告船名、船位、航行动态以及VTS中心要求的其他事项,载有危险货物的船舶还应报告所载危险货物种类、数量，拖带船舶应当报告拖带物名称、拖带长度。)
Arrival report after berthing or anchoring: name, berth or anchor position, time completed. (到达报告：靠泊或锚泊后报告船名，泊位或锚位，完成时间。)
Shift report before shifting: name, present berth or anchorage, berth or anchorage you are going to. (移泊报告：移泊前报告船名，当前泊位或锚地，预抵泊位或锚地。)
Sailing report before sailing: name, departure position, expected time of entering the channel, next port. (开航报告：开航前报告船名，离港位置，预计进入航道的时间和下一港。)

Anchoring / heaving up report before anchoring or heaving up in an anchorage: name, position; when heaving up to go in, also the berth, and the time and position of entering the channel. (抛/起锚报告：在锚地抛/起锚前应报告船名、船位，起锚进港时还应报告拟靠泊位、预计进入航道的时间、位置。)
Before crossing a channel, a routeing area, the Penglai-Changdao route or a temporary control area: report before entering and cross only with permission (rules art. 7).

Before starting and after finishing: opening up boilers, main engine, windlass, steering gear or main navigation equipment; sea or engine trials; going alongside at anchor; towing connect or let go; oily water or waste handling; other work affecting safety (art. 11).

Emergency and abnormal reports at once by every means: accident, pollution, machinery damage, injury, security incident; aids to navigation not normal, obstructions, drifting objects (arts. 8 and 9). Pilots report boarding and leaving: ship, time, place, pilot's name or number (art. 12).

verification: Rules, user guide, centres, radii, channels and contacts read from the official .docx attached to the Shandong MSA notice of 3 March 2023 (sd.msa.gov.cn), compared with the mcrrc.top copy: same. Positions printed in degrees and decimal minutes and copied with only the notation changed.
notes: Reporting line = the 12 NM arc round Jimu Jiao lighthouse from 37°29.32′N 120°10.25′E to 37°47.12′N 120°26.54′E; the area is the water between that arc and the coast. The area paragraph of the rules leaves N and E off the arc end point; the reporting-line paragraph prints them. The English guide gives the lighthouse as 37°41.13′N, the Chinese 37°41.12′N. Longkou No. 4 anchorage (user guide): 37°40.7′N 120°08.5′E; 37°38.8′N 120°08.5′E; 37°38.8′N 120°13.2′E; 37°40.7′N 120°11.4′E. The English guide mentions an extra report (name, position, time and position of entering the channel) before anchoring or heaving up in 'Pilotage and Quarantine Anchorage NO.4 and NO.7 of Yantai port'; this is not in the Chinese text. Coming from Chengshan Jiao a ship passes the Changshan Shuidao sector (CH 08) first; see cn-vts-yantai-changshan. Yantai VTS has six sectors, each with its own channel: Zhifu CH 09, Bajiao (West Port) CH 10, Penglai and Changdao CH 11, Longkou CH 12, Laizhou CH 14, Changshan Shuidao and Penglai outer anchorage CH 08. Reports go to the Yantai VTS Centre ('calling Yantai VTS center', 呼叫烟台交管中心) on the channel of the sector you are in. Valid to 30 April 2028 (art. 34). No overtaking in harbour channels (art. 16). Terminal owners or agents must file entry, leaving and shifting plans in advance by internet or fax (art. 17; no hours given). Lightering or going alongside at anchor must follow MOT and MSA rules and be told to the VTS. Radar blind areas: basins and berths, east of Kongtong Dao, between Nan/Bei Changshan Dao and Daheishan Dao. VTS works 0000 to 2400 Beijing time. No email address is printed. Address: 8 Huanhai Road, Yantai. VTS reports do not replace the national port entry, territorial sea or arrival reports.
